title: Comparison of 16S and whole genome dog microbiomes using machine learning.
summary: 16S and WGS microbiome datasets from the same dogs are compared for taxonomic resolution and host-phenotype classification. The study establishes how sequencing modality changes the captured dog gut microbiome and classification performance; specific comparative microbiome result with an appropriate cross-method analysis.
